content: MutationObserver self-retrigger mitigations: (1) narrow observation - childList+subtree only, omit attributes, or use attributeFilter to exclude your own attribute; (2) idempotence guard - read current state and return early if the desired value is already set, so a self-triggered pass is a no-op and the loop terminates after one extra cycle; (3) debounce with a microtask/rAF/short timeout to coalesce React render batches; (4) disconnect/takeRecords/reconnect around the write - takeRecords() drains and discards pending records before reconnecting, but is fragile because it also discards genuine page mutations. Best practice for extensions: write only a data-* attribute, do not observe attributes at all, and keep the write idempotent.
